included: Implementation seal, evidence seal, ancestry checks, dirty-tree checks, and exact digest bindings.

deliverables.description: Two-phase Git evidence seal coordinator and verifier.

dependency-hints.rationale: The evidence commit seals the complete immutable receipt set.

objective: Implement two-phase Git sealing that binds an implementation commit to a later evidence commit without self-reference.

required-evidence.description: The evidence seal proves exact implementation ancestry and evidence bytes without embedding either commit's identity in itself.

checks.method: Create temporary repositories and verify valid two-phase seals plus self-reference, wrong-parent, dirty-tree, stale, and tampered-evidence failures.
